_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-09 04:13:33Z)**_

This is a Gatsby 5 site. To run it locally:

```bash
npm install      # node_modules isn't installed yet
npm run develop  # or: npm start
```

Then open http://localhost:8000. GraphiQL is at http://localhost:8000/___graphql.

- Gatsby 5 needs **Node 18 or newer**. Check yours with `node -v`.
- Use npm, not yarn. The yarn.lock was removed recently and `package-lock.json` is the lockfile now.
- If you hit odd cache or build errors, run `npm run clean` and start the dev server again.
- To test a production build: `npm run build && npm run serve`, which serves it at http://localhost:9000.
